task_goal: book a pair of front tyres to be fitted at Selby Tyres and settle which car comes in and how it is paid for
tail_anchor: We're only ten minutes up the road from you.
notes: The two rep cells differ only in the payment clause of turn 2 (settling up the Monday after with nothing in the account / on the card before the car moves) against a shop that is paid before the car leaves the bay. The two norep cells differ only in the referring expression in turn 4, 'the car on the drive' against 'my wife's car', where two cars are on the drive and they take different sizes.
